summary: This note describes the song "One for My Baby (and One More for the Road)," written by Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer for the 1943 movie musical The Sky's the Limit. The song was first performed in the film by Fred Astaire and was later popularized by Frank Sinatra.
one_line: A song by Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer, first performed by Fred Astaire in The Sky's the Limit (1943) and popularized by Frank Sinatra.
key_facts: "One for My Baby (and One More for the Road)" is a hit song.
The song was written by Harold Arlen and Johnny Mercer.
The song was written for the movie musical The Sky's the Limit (1943).
Fred Astaire first performed the song in the film The Sky's the Limit.
The song was popularized by Frank Sinatra.
